guard: status projects broker display copies without secrets, represents unsafe saved addresses as unknown, and never rewrites dial input

mutations.name: recorded status rows expose raw broker URLs
mutations.expectRed: status redacts recorded broker address for password
mutations.cell: status redacts recorded broker address for password

mutations.name: selected status row exposes the raw broker URL
mutations.expectRed: status redacts selected broker address for password
mutations.cell: status redacts selected broker address for password

mutations.name: legacy component facts expose the raw broker URL
mutations.expectRed: status component facts omit broker secrets for password
mutations.cell: status component facts omit broker secrets for password

mutations.name: unsafe saved addresses pretend to be known display strings
mutations.find:
gaps.add("BROKER_ADDRESS_INVALID", `broker address for '${space}' cannot be displayed`, { space });
  return null;
mutations.replace:
gaps.add("BROKER_ADDRESS_INVALID", `broker address for '${space}' cannot be displayed`, { space });
  return "unavailable";
mutations.expectRed: status reports an invalid stored address as unknown
mutations.cell: status reports an invalid stored address as unknown

why: The focused profile keeps all real built-CLI broker-display cells and positive controls; the ordinary root suite still runs every status case.
